title: Extracellular circulating miRNAs as stress-related signature to search and rescue dogs.
authors: Guelfi, Gabriella; Iaboni, Martina; Sansone, Anna; Capaccia, Camilla; Santoro, Michele Matteo; Diverio, Silvana
one_liner_zh: 该文研究搜救犬血清循环miRNA在应激反应中的表达变化，属于纯实验测序与湿实验验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Our research explores serum extracellular circulating miRNAs (ecmiRNAs) involved in dog stress response immediately after the search and rescue (SAR) of missing people. The experimental plan considers four arduous SAR simulations. The SAR dogs are trained by the Alpine School of the Military Force of Guardia di Finanza (Passo Rolle, Italy). The First SAR Trial analyzed dog serum samples at rest time (T0), and immediately after SAR performance (T1) using the miRNome-wide screening next-generation sequencing (NGS). T1 versus T0 NGS results revealed a different expression level of let-7a and let-7f. Subsequently, in a large sample size including: 1st (n = 6), 2nd (n = 6), 3rd (n = 6), and 4th (n = 4) trials, let-7a and let-7f were validated by qPCR. Bioinformatics analysis with TarBase (v.8) and the Diana-mirPath (v.3) revealed a functional role of let-7a and let-7f in the p53 pathway to restore cellular homeostasis. Let-7a and let-7f, highly expressed at T1, could stop MDMs-p53 inhibition inducing the p53 increase in level. In addition, let-7a and let-7f, via p53 post-transcriptional regulation, buffers p53 transcription spikes. During SAR stress, the possibility of p53 preconditioning could explain the phenomenon of "stress hardening" where the tolerance of particular stress increases after preconditioning.
abstract_zh: 我们的研究探索了在搜寻失踪人员的搜救（SAR）行动后，犬只血清中参与应激反应的细胞外循环miRNAs（ecmiRNAs）。实验方案考虑了四次艰苦的SAR模拟。SAR犬由意大利金融警卫队山地学校（Passo Rolle，意大利）训练。首次SAR试验在静息时间（T0）和SAR表现后立即（T1）分析犬血清样本，采用miRNome全谱筛选的下一代测序（NGS）。T1与T0的NGS结果显示let-7a和let-7f的表达水平存在差异。随后，在大样本量中，包括第1次（n=6）、第2次（n=6）、第3次（n=6）和第4次（n=4）试验，通过qPCR验证了let-7a和let-7f。使用TarBase（v.8）和Diana-mirPath（v.3）进行的生物信息学分析揭示了let-7a和let-7f在p53通路中的功能作用，以恢复细胞稳态。在T1时高表达的let-7a和let-7f可能阻止MDMs-p53抑制，诱导p53水平升高。此外，let-7a和let-7f通过p53转录后调控，缓冲p53转录峰值。在SAR应激期间，p53预适应的可能性可能解释“应激硬化”现象，即在预适应后对特定应激的耐受性增加。
